Function_Description: Network interface IP address the HTTP/1.1 + SSE server binds to.
How_Server_Handles_It: Parsed into RuntimeConfig::bind_host and passed to pelias::os::NetServer::bind_and_listen().
How_Server_Interprets_And_Routes: Routes directly to OS socket layer (src/os/net_win32.cpp or net_posix.cpp); overrides loopback-only default when profile/CLI specifies LAN or 0.0.0.0.

Function_Description: TCP port for HTTP/1.1 API, SSE streaming, and embedded Web GUI.
How_Server_Handles_It: Parsed into RuntimeConfig::bind_port and validated for uint16_t bounds.
How_Server_Interprets_And_Routes: Routes to pelias::os::NetServer::bind_and_listen() and updates Web UI / health endpoint metadata.

Function_Description: Socket read/write and keep-alive idle timeout in milliseconds.
How_Server_Handles_It: Configured on non-blocking client sockets in src/serve/server.cpp.
How_Server_Interprets_And_Routes: Interprets value as poll/select timeout in the HTTP request loop to prevent hung connections.

Function_Description: Enables or disables the embedded zero-dependency HTML5/JS/CSS control panel at GET / and GET /ui.
How_Server_Handles_It: Toggles route registration for GET / and GET /ui in src/serve/server.cpp.
How_Server_Interprets_And_Routes: When true, serves constexpr string_view payload from src/serve/web_ui.cpp; when false, returns 404 on UI routes for headless operation.

Function_Description: Path to the GGUF v3 model file to serve.
How_Server_Handles_It: Passed to pelias::io::GgufReader::open() using 64-bit file mapping/offsets (_fseeki64 / CreateFileMappingW / mmap).
How_Server_Interprets_And_Routes: Reads GGUF header, computes SHA-256 + metadata shape ModelKey (U4), populates ModelSpec dynamically (MoE vs Dense, layer types, quant types), and routes tensors to WeightMap.

Function_Description: Controls how cold expert and model weights are mapped and loaded from disk into host RAM.
How_Server_Handles_It: Dispatched in src/os/file_map_* and src/hal/host_alloc_*.
How_Server_Interprets_And_Routes: Interprets 'none' as anonymous 4-KB page load (doubles prefill speed on virtualized guests), 'mmap' as OS view mapping, 'pinned_2mib' as cudaHostAllocMapped 2 MiB aligned chunks, and 'mem_large_pages' as Win32 MEM_LARGE_PAGES (G5).

Function_Description: Runs per-tensor SHA-256 / GPU zero-copy read checksum verification on startup.
How_Server_Handles_It: Invokes pelias::io::sha256 or GPU uint4 checksum kernel during WeightMap initialization.
How_Server_Interprets_And_Routes: Routes to startup verification pipeline; halts server startup with StatusCode::GgufParseError if bit-rot or offset corruption is detected.

Function_Description: Explicitly governs whether extra draft blocks (e.g., blk.40 MTP) are loaded into the active graph or skipped cleanly without unaccounted VRAM leaks.
How_Server_Handles_It: Checked in ModelTopology::from_gguf() when block_count > trunk_layer_count.
How_Server_Interprets_And_Routes: When mtp_draft_n == 0 or ignore_unused_mtp_tensors == true, prevents allocating or splitting the 41st block (fixing the 82-split / unused blk.40 anomaly from §1.22 and D5).

Function_Description: Hard VRAM cap enforced by VramGovernor before any cudaMalloc is permitted.
How_Server_Handles_It: Passed to VramGovernor::probe_and_init().
How_Server_Interprets_And_Routes: Queries CUDA free and NVML free after context creation, takes min(cuda_free, nvml_free) - margin (U2 / D28), or applies UserForced override (U11); refuses any ArenaPlan exceeding ceiling with StatusCode::OutOfVramBudget.

Function_Description: Safety headroom subtracted from probed free VRAM to absorb desktop/display driver drift.
How_Server_Handles_It: Converted to bytes and passed to VramGovernor::probe_and_init(margin_bytes).
How_Server_Interprets_And_Routes: Directly reduces judged_free_bytes inside VramGovernor so background OS display activity never triggers OOM or silent system-RAM spill (N1).

Function_Description: Selects whether the VRAM ceiling is judged against process-available post-context free memory (P) or whole-card NVML used memory (W) (X15 / Decision 7).
How_Server_Handles_It: Evaluated in VramGovernor::probe_and_init().
How_Server_Interprets_And_Routes: Routes to NVML + CUDA runtime memory queries in src/hal/device.cpp, computing exact Δ_max headroom for the hot bank and scratch arenas.

Function_Description: Size of the static VRAM bank holding the hottest routed MoE experts (or offloaded dense layers).
How_Server_Handles_It: Registered as an ArenaLifetime::Process entry in VramGovernor and passed to HotSetSolver.
How_Server_Interprets_And_Routes: Water-fills VRAM slots across trunk layers (plus 1 all-zero slot per MoE layer so cold/unselected IDs map to slot 0 instead of -1) and routes resident expert IDs to the GPU MMQ hot branch.

Function_Description: Maximum host RAM pinned via cudaHostAllocMapped | cudaHostAllocPortable for the cold expert store.
How_Server_Handles_It: Governs PinnedHostPool::init() in src/hal/host_alloc.h.
How_Server_Interprets_And_Routes: Allocates 1 GiB mapped chunks, verifies device pointer mapping (supporting constant dev_base - host_base offsets via Path A), and triggers the 3-step fallback chain if allocation fails.

Function_Description: Locks the hot loop against dynamic allocations (HotLoopAllocationFault) and monitors runtime VRAM headroom and thermal/clock drop.
How_Server_Handles_It: Enforced by VramGovernor::lock_hot_loop(true) and poll_runtime_headroom().
How_Server_Interprets_And_Routes: During decode_step(), any unexpected allocation or critical VRAM/clock drop cleanly aborts the step before driver instability occurs (can only be bypassed in Expert Mode U11).

Function_Description: Waits for GPU memory to settle and flushes/retries once if a startup probe or arena commit spikes (U5).
How_Server_Handles_It: Handled in startup probe and VramGovernor::commit_plan().
How_Server_Interprets_And_Routes: Polls NVML free memory between startup stages and executes cudaDeviceSynchronize() + cache flush before retrying a failed allocation.

Function_Description: Number of MoE layers whose cold experts are eligible for CPU/PCIe dual-bus execution.
How_Server_Handles_It: Stored in RuntimeConfig and applied in WeightMap::partition_weights().
How_Server_Interprets_And_Routes: Determines which layers participate in the hot/cold split vs full VRAM residency; for Dense models (num_experts == 0), acts as a layer offload count if model > VRAM ceiling.

Function_Description: Path to pre-profiled PELIAS_HOT_SET expert residency list.
How_Server_Handles_It: Loaded by pelias::model::HotSetIo::load() in src/model/hot_set_io.cpp.
How_Server_Interprets_And_Routes: Maps each (layer, expert_id) to either its VRAM bank slot (1..N) or the cold path (0 = all-zero slot on GPU + cold request in DoorbellMailbox).

Function_Description: Objective function used when water-filling the VRAM hot bank from routing traces (F11 / B1.7).
How_Server_Handles_It: Passed to HotSetIo::solve_waterfill().
How_Server_Interprets_And_Routes: When 'byte_hit_rate', maximizes h (accounting for 498 MiB Q6_K vs 432 MiB Q4_K layers); when 'zero_miss_share', maximizes Z_l based on P-E2 c0/c1 regression weights.

Function_Description: Controls whether the 10 full-attention layers receive uniform water-filling weights or priority residency weights (F9 / Mode L-Z).
How_Server_Handles_It: Applied as layer multipliers in HotSetIo::solve_waterfill().
How_Server_Interprets_And_Routes: Defaults to uniform (per P-E1 proof that forcing 100% full-attn residency costs 4.605 GiB and drops hit rate to 0.7114), while allowing gated Mode L-Z testing.

Function_Description: Chunk token threshold at or above which execution bypasses the token-major dual-bus path and uses the batch prefill path.
How_Server_Handles_It: Checked at the start of DecodeEngine::prefill_or_decode_chunk().
How_Server_Interprets_And_Routes: When chunk_tokens < tier_bypass_n, dispatches through the hot-bank + doorbell cold-expert split; when >= tier_bypass_n, routes to the high-throughput chunked prefill path (§8.4 / §8.7).

Function_Description: Fraction of cold-miss expert SwiGLU rows (on 256-row QK_K boundaries) computed by GPU zero-copy vs CPU AVX2 threads.
How_Server_Handles_It: Configured in MissSplitter (src/bus/doorbell.cuh & src/engine/decode_engine.cpp).
How_Server_Interprets_And_Routes: Splits cold expert work across the dual bus (0.0 = all cold misses on CPU; 0.44 = measured 21.06 / 47.62 GB/s PCIe share; 0.60 = Pass 1 default) with carried rounding error.

Function_Description: Enables live per-layer hot-bank hit-rate and miss-histogram counting (1-token vs 2..31-token batches).
How_Server_Handles_It: Incremented atomically in the router/splitter step without stopping the CUDA graph.
How_Server_Interprets_And_Routes: Unlike the prototype's eval-callback patch (which slowed decode by stopping the scheduler), counts hits in-place and exports live telemetry to /health and PELIAS_TIER_STATS_FILE.

Function_Description: File path to write JSON routing hit rates and latency statistics on server exit or checkpoint.
How_Server_Handles_It: Handled by DecodeEngine::write_stats_json().
How_Server_Interprets_And_Routes: Serializes per-layer hit rates, 0..8 miss histograms, and token latencies to disk via pelias::io::json.

Function_Description: Maximum sequence context length allocated in the KV cache and recurrent state arena.
How_Server_Handles_It: Passed to KvStateCache::init() in ArenaLifetime::Session.
How_Server_Interprets_And_Routes: Sizes the 10 FullGQA KV cache tensors and 30 GatedDeltaNet state buffers inside VramGovernor's Session arena.

Function_Description: Logical maximum prompt batch size accepted in a single prefill pass.
How_Server_Handles_It: Governs outer prefill chunking loop in DecodeEngine::prefill().
How_Server_Interprets_And_Routes: Slices incoming tokenized prompts into logical batches of at most batch_size before micro-batching.

Function_Description: Physical micro-batch token count governing scratch activation buffer allocation during prefill.
How_Server_Handles_It: Sizes ArenaLifetime::StepOrPrefill scratch arena in VramGovernor.
How_Server_Interprets_And_Routes: Directly controls prefill scratch VRAM (trading ~256 MiB between -ub 2048 and -ub 4096 against Δ_max core headroom, F6) and prefill throughput.

Function_Description: Data type used to store FullGQA Key and Value cache tensors in VRAM.
How_Server_Handles_It: Configured in KvStateCache::init() and FullGQA attention kernels.
How_Server_Interprets_And_Routes: Selects block_q8_0 (34 B / 32 elems) or unquantized F16/BF16/F32 storage, routing attention score/value kernels to the matching dequantizer.

Function_Description: Caches and reuses matching token prefixes across multi-turn chat requests without re-prefilling (5d_prompt_reuse).
How_Server_Handles_It: Implemented via token-prefix SHA-256/rolling hash in KvStateCache.
How_Server_Interprets_And_Routes: Compares incoming chat token array against the active session prefix; skips prefill for all matching prefix tokens and advances straight to the new turn suffix.

Function_Description: Chunk length C used for parallel WY/UT linear-attention prefill across the 30 Gated DeltaNet layers.
How_Server_Handles_It: Passed to spine_ops::deltanet_chunked_prefill_cuda().
How_Server_Interprets_And_Routes: Executes chunked parallel state updates during prefill (C=64 default per arXiv:2406.06484) and switches to recurrent step S_t during single-token decode.

Function_Description: Number of CPU worker threads in the persistent cold-expert threadpool during token decode.
How_Server_Handles_It: Passed to CpuThreadPool::init() in src/bus/cpu_threadpool.cpp.
How_Server_Interprets_And_Routes: Spawns N persistent workers; defaults to physical_cores - 1 (e.g., 7 on an 8C/16T CPU) so core 0 remains dedicated to the GPU decode/control thread.

Function_Description: Number of CPU threads used during large-batch prefill or host-side tasks.
How_Server_Handles_It: Configured in CpuThreadPool and prefill dispatcher.
How_Server_Interprets_And_Routes: Utilizes all physical cores during batch operations where the GPU control thread is not spinning on per-layer doorbells.

Function_Description: Thread affinity policy mapping worker threads to CPU cores (G6 / F4).
How_Server_Handles_It: Executed via CPUID topology discovery in src/os/threads.cpp.
How_Server_Interprets_And_Routes: Detects AMD CCDs vs Intel hybrid P/E cores; pins 1 thread per physical core (or P-core) to prevent SMT 50/50 Load/Store/Retire queue partitioning.

Function_Description: Issues non-temporal _mm_prefetch(..., _MM_HINT_NTA) instructions when streaming cold experts on CPU (G8).
How_Server_Handles_It: Toggled as a template/runtime branch in quant_cpu.cpp and cpu_threadpool.cpp.
How_Server_Interprets_And_Routes: Prevents one-shot cold expert weight reads from evicting hot data out of victim L3 caches (such as 3D V-Cache).

Function_Description: Controls how aggressively CPU worker threads spin-wait on the DoorbellMailbox vs yielding.
How_Server_Handles_It: Governs spin loop in CpuThreadPool::worker_loop() using acquire loads.
How_Server_Interprets_And_Routes: At 100, workers spin using plain MOV acquire loads (zero LOCK XCHG per AMD SOG §2.15, G7) for 3.4 µs flag visibility; lower values insert _mm_pause() / sleep backoff.

Function_Description: Sets OS thread scheduling priority, disabling Windows power throttling (HighQoS) and setting 1 ms timer resolution (G18 / G11).
How_Server_Handles_It: Applied in src/os/threads.cpp via SetThreadInformation / timeBeginPeriod(1) on Win32 or /dev/cpu_dma_latency on Linux.
How_Server_Interprets_And_Routes: Eliminates OS scheduler wake jitter and timer tick overshoot (P-M3) across both Windows-native and Linux/WSL2.

Function_Description: Selects the active hardware compute backend (F3).
How_Server_Handles_It: Inspected in pelias::hal::Device::init().
How_Server_Interprets_And_Routes: Queries R1 (zero-copy host read), R2 (microsecond doorbell visibility), and R3 (resident wait kernel); routes to native CUDA sm_89 fast-path or auto-selects stream_sync fallback when R2/R3 are unsupported.

Function_Description: Selects how GPU and CPU synchronize 40 times per token on cold expert misses.
How_Server_Handles_It: Dispatched in DecodeEngine::decode_layer_moe().
How_Server_Interprets_And_Routes: When 'doorbell', uses the 13.3 µs resident-kernel DoorbellMailbox (__nanosleep(64) backoff); when 'stream_sync' (or on DoorbellTimeout), falls back to 94 µs OS stream synchronization.

Function_Description: Maximum microseconds the resident GPU kernel waits on DoorbellMailbox::ack_seq before triggering clean fallback.
How_Server_Handles_It: Checked inside doorbell.cu wait kernel.
How_Server_Interprets_And_Routes: If exceeded, sets DoorbellMailbox::status_code to DoorbellTimeout and cleanly completes the layer via host stream_sync without hanging the display driver (P-H13).

Function_Description: Inserts (void)cudaStreamQuery(stream) immediately after enqueuing work on non-blocking streams (D27 / P-H12).
How_Server_Handles_It: Executed in StageMajorStreamer and DecodeEngine stream enqueues.
How_Server_Interprets_And_Routes: Forces WDDM / WSL2 /dev/dxg command batch submission immediately, lifting 3-way copy/compute overlap efficiency from 0.47 to 0.92.

Function_Description: Enables static CUDA Graph capture and replay across decode steps using fixed device-memory control structs.
How_Server_Handles_It: Managed by GraphCaptureHarness in src/bus/graph_capture.cu.
How_Server_Interprets_And_Routes: Captures the decode kernel sequence once and updates token/position/routing pointers in DeviceTokenStepCtrl, cutting per-kernel launch overhead from 2.2-4.7 µs to 0.71 µs (P-H9).

Function_Description: Uses 16-byte (uint4) coalesced PCIe reads into __shared__ memory to unpack 144B Q4_K and 210B Q6_K expert blocks (P-E10).
How_Server_Handles_It: Dispatched in src/kern/wide_load.cu.
How_Server_Interprets_And_Routes: Replaces narrow byte/halfword PCIe reads (9.59 GB/s) with coalesced 128-bit transactions (up to 26.2 GB/s) and handles 420-byte Q6_K row boundaries in shared memory.

Function_Description: Enables 432-byte padded row stride when reading repacked Q6_K expert tensors (F12 / D25).
How_Server_Handles_It: Checked in WeightMap and wide_load.cu stride calculations.
How_Server_Interprets_And_Routes: Reads standard 420-byte GGUF rows when false, or 16-byte-aligned 432-byte rows (+2.86% expert RAM) when loading a repack_gguf layout.

Function_Description: Pins spine activations and DeltaNet recurrent state in the GPU's L2 cache via cudaAccessPropertyPersisting (G10 / E-A4).
How_Server_Handles_It: Configured in KvStateCache and Device::set_l2_persistence().
How_Server_Interprets_And_Routes: Queries cudaDevAttrMaxPersistingL2CacheSize at startup and applies L2 persistence window up to the requested MiB (0 = disabled by default until E-A4 A/B passes).

Function_Description: Controls activation quantization granularity sent to the GPU hot branch vs CPU cold branch (F14 / Mode B).
How_Server_Handles_It: Dispatched in DoorbellMailbox input preparation and MMQ launch.
How_Server_Interprets_And_Routes: In 'auto'/'q8_1_gpu_q8_k_cpu', quantizes 32-element block_q8_1 for GPU MMQ and 256-element block_q8_K for CPU AVX2 (or direct FP16/BF16 for unquantized models); in 'q8_k_both', forces unified 256-element blocks.

Function_Description: Number of speculative draft tokens generated per step using the 41st MTP block (blk.40) (5e_mtp_acceptance).
How_Server_Handles_It: Governs DecodeEngine speculative loop and can be overridden per HTTP request via JSON field 'speculative.n_max'.
How_Server_Interprets_And_Routes: When > 0, runs blk.40 draft head, verifies tokens in a single trunk pass, and returns draft_n and draft_n_accepted counters in the HTTP/SSE response; when 0, completely disables drafting.

Function_Description: Gates speculative draft steps based on whether drafted experts hit the VRAM hot bank (e6_hot_aware_mtp).
How_Server_Handles_It: Evaluated in DecodeEngine before committing a draft step.
How_Server_Interprets_And_Routes: Skips speculative drafting on steps where router top-8 selections would trigger heavy cold-bus misses.

Function_Description: Maintains 62.9 MiB 30-layer Gated DeltaNet recurrent state snapshots for exact rollback on rejected draft tokens (e5_deltanet_state).
How_Server_Handles_It: Managed by KvStateCache::snapshot_deltanet() and restore_deltanet().
How_Server_Interprets_And_Routes: Restores exact recurrent state in ~0.5 ms whenever a speculative draft token is rejected so linear-attention state never drifts.

Function_Description: Sampling softmax temperature (0.0 = greedy argmax).
How_Server_Handles_It: Parsed per HTTP request in /v1/chat/completions or set as server default.
How_Server_Interprets_And_Routes: Scales output logits before top-k / top-p filtering in the native Sampler.

Function_Description: Nucleus sampling cumulative probability cutoff.
How_Server_Handles_It: Applied in Sampler::sample() after temperature scaling.
How_Server_Interprets_And_Routes: Sorts candidate probabilities and truncates the tail once cumulative probability exceeds top_p.

Function_Description: Limits sampling pool to the top K highest-probability vocabulary tokens.
How_Server_Handles_It: Applied in Sampler::sample() before softmax.
How_Server_Interprets_And_Routes: Selects top K logits on device/host before nucleus filtering (0 = disabled).

Function_Description: Minimum probability threshold relative to the most likely token.
How_Server_Handles_It: Applied in Sampler::sample().
How_Server_Interprets_And_Routes: Filters out tokens whose probability is less than min_p * max_prob.

Function_Description: Penalty applied to tokens that have already appeared in the context window.
How_Server_Handles_It: Applied in Sampler::apply_penalties() over recent token history.
How_Server_Interprets_And_Routes: Divides positive logits and multiplies negative logits of repeated tokens by repeat_penalty.

Function_Description: OpenAI-style flat additive penalty for any token present in the generated text so far.
How_Server_Handles_It: Applied in Sampler::apply_penalties().
How_Server_Interprets_And_Routes: Subtracts presence_penalty from logits of any token that appeared at least once.

Function_Description: OpenAI-style additive penalty scaled by the token's count in the generated text so far.
How_Server_Handles_It: Applied in Sampler::apply_penalties().
How_Server_Interprets_And_Routes: Subtracts frequency_penalty * count(token) from candidate logits.

Function_Description: Deterministic PRNG seed for token sampling.
How_Server_Handles_It: Seeds the per-request Xoshiro256** / Philox generator in Sampler.
How_Server_Interprets_And_Routes: Guarantees bit-identical token sequences across repeated runs when temperature > 0.

Function_Description: Maximum number of tokens to generate per completion request.
How_Server_Handles_It: Governs the decode step loop in DecodeEngine.
How_Server_Interprets_And_Routes: Stops generation once max_tokens is reached or an EOS/stop token is emitted.

Function_Description: Continues generating up to max_tokens even if the EOS token is sampled (Group J benchmark testing).
How_Server_Handles_It: Checked in DecodeEngine::decode_step() and Sampler.
How_Server_Interprets_And_Routes: Suppresses early termination on EOS so fixed-length latency and throughput sweeps (speed.py / Group J) measure exact token counts.

Function_Description: Controls whether the native Jinja chat-template evaluator injects <think>...</think> reasoning blocks.
How_Server_Handles_It: Passed into ChatTemplate::render() in src/tok/chat_template.cpp.
How_Server_Interprets_And_Routes: Evaluates the 158-line Qwen Jinja template branch for enable_thinking and tags reasoning output in SSE deltas.

Function_Description: Adapts request parsing and tool-call JSON/SSE envelopes to match the connecting client front-end (U8).
How_Server_Handles_It: Handled in src/serve/http_parser.cpp and src/tok/chat_template.cpp.
How_Server_Interprets_And_Routes: Normalizes system/developer/user/assistant/tool roles and <tool_call> envelopes across IDE extensions, local chat clients, and custom agent harnesses.

Function_Description: Splits registered added/special tokens (<|im_start|>, <|im_end|>, <think>, <tool_call>) prior to byte-level BPE merging.
How_Server_Handles_It: Executed in Tokenizer::encode() before NFC + GPT-2 byte BPE.
How_Server_Interprets_And_Routes: Ensures control and tool tokens map to their exact single token IDs (out of the 33 added tokens in the 248,320 padded vocabulary).

Function_Description: Imports a multi-format user parameter tweak file at server startup (U7).
How_Server_Handles_It: Parsed statically by ProfileIo::import_profile_file() in src/config/profile_io.cpp.
How_Server_Interprets_And_Routes: Extracts key=value pairs from .txt/.log, tables from .md, rows from .csv, or static assignments from .py (never executing Python code!) and routes every key through ParameterRegistry.

Function_Description: Allows manual parameter overrides outside auto-probed hardware bounds, tagging them as USER-FORCED (U11).
How_Server_Handles_It: Tracked via ValueOrigin::UserForced in ParameterRegistry and RuntimeConfig.
How_Server_Interprets_And_Routes: Permits advanced tuning in the .wslconfig-style editor while displaying explicit caution banners on the Plan Card and /api/config/preview.
